title: Event corpus QA + W14 adjudication + bystander_target rule
whatWasBuilt: datasets/experiments/wave-c/C06-adjudications.json - append-only adjudication records closing all 5 W14 disagreements (2 TA, 3 ownership), each from re-viewing rendered frames with +-2..3-frame temporal scrubs; no W14 artifact modified

ml/annotations/ta-ownership-annotation-guide-v1.md - versioned annotation guide: TA operational definition, the bystander_target rule with both corpus examples, deterministic TA verdict precedence, 3-frame crowd-region scrub, motion-blur center-offset rule (<=0.05 norm), 'other' hand/arm-continuity evidence standard, static-object ledger, per-verdict confidence
datasets/paddle-bench/event-bounds-qa-wave-c.json - append-only QA record for all 34 committed eventLabels with per-event verdicts and evidence; 1 correction filed

exactNumbers.adjudicationOutcomes: 5/5 uphold primary; 2 TA cases conditionally (require new bystander_target tag); ownership @2204 target (measured box-center offset ~0.04 norm, inside the codified <=0.05 band), @2604 ambiguous (no hand/arm continuity; W14's proposed owner's paddle visibly at his waist in adjacent frames), @3372 reject (floor paddle pixel-static 1303-3505ms)
exactNumbers.eventLabelBreakdown: 18 wave-a (event-bounds-wave-a.json) + 16 v1 (afn-sasebo-rally1 x7, afn-sasebo-rally2 x2, afn-vic-rally1 x3, wm-dink-01 x2, wm-volley-02 x2)

provenance: Frames rendered with ffmpeg+Pillow from: committed bundle clips (afn-sasebo-rally1, wm-dink-01, wm-volley-02) and re-downloaded source media (Wikimedia Commons sasebo + AFN VIC webm, DVIDS 944593/944209/944403/1011384) verified against datasets/corpus/fingerprints/<recordingId>.json by per-second dhash match before use. Recording->source time offsets taken from recordings.json derivedFrom time_crop entries (e.g. afn-sasebo-rally2 = source+30.6s, afn-vic-rally1 = source+22.0s).
keyFinding: FLAG/CORR-C06-1: afn-sasebo-rally1 eventLabels[1] (partner swing, contact 3870) - the clip has a hard camera cut between 3837 and 3850; the labeled contact and end lie beyond the cut in a different camera, invalidating the v1 ball-turn evidence. recordings.json rec-21fb75446a03 claims 'Single continuous shot', which is also wrong (source cuts at ~29.85s). Filed append-only; source annotation untouched (integrator to dispose).
honestNegatives: 11/34 events are PASS_CONSISTENT, not PASS_VERIFIED: the touch frame itself is occluded or below resolvable size (far-court small figures, paddle-occluded contacts, held-out low-res clips). Their bounds are consistent with trajectory evidence but the contact instant is not directly observable.

wavea-marne-dig initially looked wrong under fast-seek rendering (multiple simultaneous feed balls alias badly); an accurate-seek frame dump reproduced the label's ball-reversal evidence. Fast-seek contact sheets are unreliable for this scene.
wavea-sasebo-volleys idx1 note says 'far white-shirt' but the striker's shirt reads blue in zoom - description nit, bounds verified.

Held-out cases (afn-vic-rally1, wm-dink-01) were reviewed observation-only per split discipline; nothing was iterated against them. Their 5 events are all PASS_CONSISTENT (none directly verifiable at source resolution/angle).
TA kappa itself was NOT recomputed: n=12 with prevalence-dominated marginals makes kappa statistically uninformative (W14's own caveat); the deliverable is the definitional fix, not a new kappa.
blocked: Cannot re-render the canonical TA windows or regenerate runs: pnpm lab:regen requires macOS Apple Vision pose extraction and canonical runs/ dirs are absent by design on this box. TA adjudications therefore used the frozen region coordinates from W14 artifacts against provenance-verified source frames.

Disposition of CORR-C06-1 (truncate vs drop the flagged event, and the recordings.json note fix) belongs to the corpus owner/integrator; not applied here to keep originals append-only and scope minimal.
testsAndTypecheck: No package source touched (data/docs-only change: 2 new JSON records, 1 new versioned guide, 1 new summary). Root pnpm typecheck run for safety; see branch CI.
